grammar.summary: 本课学习 be busy doing 与混合时态日常叙事。

points.title: busy doing
points.explanation: My hands were covered with flour. be covered with = 覆盖着；busy + doing = 忙于做。

examples.en: I was busy mixing butter and flour.
examples.cn: 我正忙着搅拌黄油和面粉。

points.title: soon after / the moment 表时间紧接
points.explanation: The moment he saw me, he... 一……就；soon after 不久之后。

examples.en: Soon after that, the telephone rang.
